questions.question: 'Ungalil Oruvan' (One Among You) is the autobiography of which of the following chief ministers?

questions.solution:

Key Points

  • M.K. Stalin is the current Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.
  • He assumed office on 7 May 2021.
  • M.K. Stalin is the son of the former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, M. Karunanidhi.
  • He is a prominent leader of the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party.

Additional Information

  • M.K. Stalin:
    • M.K. Stalin (Muthuvel Karunanidhi Stalin) was born on 1 March 1953 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

    • The DMK has been involved in various state and national level political activities and has formed the government in Tamil Nadu multiple times.
  • Autobiography:
    • An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of a person.
    • It provides insights into the personal and professional life of the author, including their experiences, challenges, and achievements.
    • Autobiographies are valuable historical documents as they offer first-hand accounts of events and people from the perspective of the author.
  • Chief Minister:
    • The Chief Minister is the head of the government in a state in India.
    • The Chief Minister is elected by the legislative assembly of the state and is appointed by the Governor.
    • The role of the Chief Minister includes formulating policies, implementing laws, and overseeing the administration of the state government.
    • The Chief Minister is also responsible for representing the state in various national and international forums.

questions.question: Who is the author of the book 'A Life Misspent'?
questions.questionHtml: Who is the author of the book 'A Life Misspent'?
questions.solution: Suryakant Tripathi Nirala, a renowned Hindi poet, novelist, essayist, and story-writer, is the author of the book 'A Life Misspent'. Born on February 21, 1896, and passing away on October 15, 1961, he is celebrated for his distinct style and profound impact on Hindi literature. Nirala is considered one of the four pillars of the Chhayavaad era, alongside Jaishankar Prasad, Sumitranandan Pant, and Mahadevi Varma. His other notable works include 'Saroj Smriti', 'Kukurmutta', and 'Parimal'. Nirala's contributions continue to influence modern Hindi literature, appreciated by scholars and readers.

    • On December 30, 2021, the Sahitya Akademi Award 2021 was given for literary works in 20 Indian languages. Namita Gokhale received the award for her novel ‘Things to Leave Behind’ and Anuradha Sarma Pujari for her Assamese novel ‘Iyat Ekhan Aaronya Asil’.

questions.question: In 1915, who wrote and published the ground-breaking book: ‘The Origin of Continents and Oceans’, which discusses the motion of Earth's continents?
questions.questionHtml: In 1915, who wrote and published the ground-breaking book: ‘The Origin of Continents and Oceans’, which discusses the motion of Earth's continents?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Alfred Wegener.

Key Points

  • Wegener was a German meteorologist, geophysicist and polar researcher.
  • In 1915 he published 'The Origin of Continents and Oceans, which outlined his theory of Continental Drift.
  • The origin of continents and ocean basins occurred due to movements of the tectonic plates in the lithosphere of Earth.
  • Wegner's theory states that when the subducts and collision among the continents occurs, the plates of the mantle and the crust in the Earth's lithosphere diverge gradually into distinct segments.

Additional Information

  • Edward Wellington Backus was a timber baron, dam builder, mill owner, financier, developer of the northern reaches of Minnesota, and president of the Ontario & Minnesota Power Company and Minnesota and Ontario Paper Company.
  • Harry Hammond Hess was an American geologist and a United States Navy officer in World War II who is considered one of the "founding fathers" of the unifying theory of plate tectonics.
  • Louis Agricola Bauer was an American geophysicist, astronomer and magnetician.

questions.question: Who among the following published the book ‘Stripurushtulna’, criticising the social differences between men and women?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following published the book ‘Stripurushtulna’, criticising the social differences between men and women?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Tarabai Shinde.

Key Points

  • Tarabai Shinde was a pioneering feminist and social reformer from Maharashtra during the late 19th century.
  • She authored the book Stripurushtulna in 1882, which is regarded as one of the first feminist critiques of gender inequality in India.
  • In Stripurushtulna, Shinde highlighted the unequal treatment and societal norms that discriminated against women compared to men.
  • The book was a reaction to prevailing patriarchal attitudes and was inspired by a specific case where a widow was accused of immorality.
  • Tarabai Shinde’s work laid the foundation for modern feminist thought in India and challenged oppressive traditions.

Additional Information

  • Feminism in India: Feminist movements in India began to emerge during the colonial period, addressing issues such as women's education, suffrage, and social reforms.
  • Social Reformers: Figures like Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar, Pandita Ramabai, and Raja Ram Mohan Roy also contributed to improving women's rights in India during the 19th century.
  • Widow Remarriage Act: Enacted in 1856, this law allowed widows to remarry, breaking traditional restrictions and initiating changes in societal attitudes.
  • Gender Inequality: Gender-based discrimination remains a significant issue globally, with efforts ongoing to achieve equal rights and opportunities for all genders.
  • Stripurushtulna: The title translates to "A Comparison Between Women and Men," reflecting the content of the book that critiques gender biases and societal injustices.

questions.question: ‘The Truths We Hold: An American Journey’ is an autobiography of which political leader?
questions.questionHtml: ‘The Truths We Hold: An American Journey’ is an autobiography of which political leader?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Kamala Harris.

Key Points

  • Kamala Harris is the 49th and current Vice President of the United States, serving since January 20, 2021.
  • She is the first female Vice President and the highest-ranking female official in U.S. history, as well as the first African American and first Asian American Vice President.
  • Prior to her vice presidency, Harris served as the junior United States Senator from California from 2017 to 2021 and as the Attorney General of California from 2011 to 2017.
  • Her autobiography, "The Truths We Hold: An American Journey," offers insights into her personal and political journey, discussing her career and the values that have driven her work in public service.

Additional Information

  • Kamala Harris's Background
    • Kamala Devi Harris was born on October 20, 1964, in Oakland, California, to immigrant parents. Her mother, Shyamala Gopalan, was a breast cancer scientist from India, and her father, Donald Harris, is an economist from Jamaica.
    • She graduated from Howard University and the University of California, Hastings College of the Law.
  • Political Career
    • Harris began her career in the Alameda County District Attorney's Office, before being recruited to the San Francisco District Attorney's Office and later the City Attorney of San Francisco's office.
    • In 2003, she was elected District Attorney of San Francisco. In 2010, she was elected Attorney General of California, being re-elected in 2014.
    • She was elected to the United States Senate in 2016, becoming the second African American woman and the first South Asian American to serve in the U.S. Senate.
  • Vice Presidency
    • Kamala Harris was selected by Joe Biden as his running mate for the 2020 United States presidential election. They won the election, defeating the incumbent President Donald Trump and Vice President Mike Pence.
    • As Vice President, Harris has focused on issues such as immigration, voting rights, and the COVID-19 pandemic.
  • The Truths We Hold: An American Journey
    • The book was published in January 2019, ahead of her presidential campaign announcement.
    • It provides a narrative of her upbringing, her career as a prosecutor and politician, and her vision for the future of America.
    • The autobiography reflects her commitment to justice, equality, and her belief in the importance of public service.
